{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
This '''individual''' was a user of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] who was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

{{RPG|''[[Heart of Evil: A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance|A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance]]''}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] user traveled to the [[Darkside (sector)|Darkside]] district of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant Undercity]] and attacked the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]]. The individual used a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to cut off Ezzar's hands, then stabbed the Dark Jedi in the heart, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Roleplaying game|role-playing]] supplement ''[[Heart of Evil: A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance|A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance]]'' the player characters fight against Garth Ezzar and if the players are defeated by Ezzar, or if Ezzar attempts to flee from them, the Dark Jedi meets an off-stage death, at the hands of this individual.
